verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to set up autonomous, background-running automations such as scheduled or recurring agent jobs. The AI Agent only works on demand: the user describes what they want and it edits through the open editor. Webhooks and the Real-time API do 'automatically trigger actions' and 'automate responses', but these are event-driven interactions inside a scene, an adjacent feature rather than background automations a user configures to run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
